00-clean-pr.title: Clean PR: a human adds AC-auth-007, the agent implements it properly

A1-operation-missing.title: A sign-out requirement is implemented without adding it to the contract

A2-unlinked-operation.title: The agent adds DELETE /session to the contract without naming a requirement

A3-lint.title: The agent loosens the session response schema

A4-breaking-change.title: The agent renames token to access_token in contract, code and tests; the spec didn't change

A5-shadow-route.title: The agent ships GET /debug/users, which isn't in the contract

A6-leaked-field.title: The login response leaks a debug_password field; tests still pass

A6-undocumented-status.title: Lockout switches to HTTP 423 and the test is updated to match; the contract isn't

A7-server-error.title: Password reset crashes on emails without "@"; the tagged tests only use valid emails

H1-wip-commit.title: The agent commits with the subject "wip"

H2-no-refs.title: The agent changes code without saying which requirement it serves

H3-two-requirements.title: One code commit claims two requirements

H4-refactor-changes-behavior.title: A "refactor" commit quietly changes the lockout comparison

H5-huge-commit.title: The agent adds a 600-line file in one commit

H6-branch-name.title: The agent works on a branch called quick-fix

H7-rewrite-main.title: The last verified commit on main is amended, rewriting main's history

H8-no-attribution.title: The agent commits without naming itself

H9-unsigned.title: The agent makes an unsigned commit

T1-duplicate-id.title: The agent adds a requirement that reuses the ID AC-auth-006

T2-not-implemented.title: A requirement is added and nothing implements it

T3-comment-only.title: The agent cites AC-auth-007 but its commit only adds a comment

T4-no-tests.title: The agent implements AC-auth-007 without any tests

T5-failing-test.title: The agent changes the lockout threshold to 4; the lockout tests now fail

T5-suite-broken.title: The agent renames something the tests depend on but doesn't update the tests, so the suite can't load

T6-assert-true.title: The agent adds a test named for AC-auth-007 that only asserts true

T7-weak-tests.title: The agent "simplifies" the lockout tests so they only check for 401

defects: impl tag points to a requirement that doesn't exist at that revision
utest tag points to a requirement that doesn't exist at that revision
T8-spec-changed.title: Product changes the lockout rule from 3 to 5 attempts; no code changes

X1-claims-only.title: Isolates T3: the implementation is a comment and the tagged test is assert True

X2-spec-changed-no-bump.title: Isolates T8: the spec wording changes and nobody bumps the OFT revision

X3-weak-tests-same-names.title: Isolates T7: lockout tests keep their names but stop checking the lockout
